public abstract static class Pos.Printable extends Pos.Posable implements INode
A Posable that also implements INode, with toString() delegating to Printer. This toString() exists purely for debugger/IDE display convenience - it must never be relied on for program logic or real output. Production code that needs to render a node must go through IPrinter/Printer explicitly (e.g. smtConfig.defaultPrinter.toString(...)), not this method.
